identity_confirmations.statement: Envy signed the full ex-3DMAX roster (Maka, Lucky, misutaaa, Graviti, Kursy) on 2026-09-29. HLTV states the new Envy squad 'is currently ranked No. 21 in the global VRS standings', which is VRS row #21 '3DMAX' in Valve's 2026-10-05 file. Valve's VRS treats rosters sharing >= 3 players as the same entity, so that row's points apply to Envy.
